name: Tokugawa Ieyasu
source:
A gentle and shy pure youth who hates standing out.
He's staying at Azuchi Castle as a visitor.
He hates disputes and he always acts quietly in order to be inconspicuous.
He unfashionably hides his face with his bangs and avoids associating with people.
